name: oct-26-nov-1
note: Bridge batch, Mon Oct 26 to Sun Nov 1, both channels, planned Oct 22 under the round-one composition rules (steps interiors, one badge home per surface, underline never wraps, flagged photos refused). Instagram: a Monday board reel, a Tuesday three-dinner carousel from the same board, the Wednesday COOKBOOK receipt reel (the week's comment-COOKBOOK post, a reel because the ask has to be earned by content), the Thursday send-this (series ledger), a Friday herbs-to-pesto split and a Sunday text thread. Pinterest: two pins a weekday; five to the two live recipe pages, one to the cookbook with the password in the URL and description, four to the App Store. Every photo opened before use: fridge-stocked, fridge-real-mess, fridge-organized, fridge-full-produce, mother-child-cooking, mother-child-meal, couple-cooking and woman-grocery-shopping are now flagged brand-in-frame (the fridge category is down to two anti-fridge shots: the photo brief needs clean fridge shelves first). Receipt math: 6.49 + 2.29 + 5.99 + 3.49 + 1.98 + 0.99 + 2.99 + 7.99 + 1.79 = 34.00. All four receipt dishes are real cookbook recipes. Reels are silent until a Meta Sound Collection bed arrives in the Drive inbox; they can be re-rendered and swapped in Buffer by URL.
